task_completion.description: A tiddler titled 'Post-Mortem Dashboard' is created and tagged with 'Dashboard'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler window showing the title 'Post-Mortem Dashboard' and the tag 'Dashboard' in the tag pill area.

task_completion.description: The dashboard contains a list that dynamically displays tiddlers tagged 'PostMortem'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The body of the 'Post-Mortem Dashboard' tiddler shows a list of links or titles corresponding to existing PostMortem entries.

task_completion.description: A button labeled 'Create New Post-Mortem' is visible on the dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A button element within the 'Post-Mortem Dashboard' tiddler with the exact text 'Create New Post-Mortem'.

task_completion.description: Clicking the button generates a new tiddler titled 'New Post-Mortem Report' with tags 'PostMortem' and 'Draft'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new tiddler in edit mode or view mode with the title 'New Post-Mortem Report' and tags 'PostMortem' and 'Draft' visible.

task_completion.description: The new tiddler contains the fields 'incident_date' and 'severity' with the specified placeholders.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the tiddler edit view or info panel, fields named 'incident_date' (value: YYYY-MM-DD) and 'severity' (value: SEV-) are present.

task_completion.description: The body of the new tiddler contains the required Markdown/Wikitext headings and placeholders.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text area of the new tiddler shows '!! Summary', '!! Root Cause', and '!! Resolution' with their respective '(enter...)' placeholders.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and configure tiddlers rather than just editing underlying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking the '+' button, typing in the tiddler editor, and using the 'save' (checkmark) icon.

integrity.description: The dashboard list is dynamic (using a filter) rather than a static list of manually typed names.
integrity.visual_evidence: In edit mode, the dashboard tiddler should show code like '<$list filter="[tag[PostMortem]]">' rather than a hardcoded list of titles.

integrity.description: The button uses TiddlyWiki action widgets to create the tiddler.
integrity.visual_evidence: The code for the button in the dashboard tiddler uses '<$button>' and '<$action-createtiddler>' or similar widgets.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dashboard must be titled 'Post-Mortem Dashboard' and tagged 'Dashboard'. It must list tiddlers tagged 'PostMortem'. The button 'Create New Post-Mortem' must trigger the creation of a tiddler with: Title: 'New Post-Mortem Report'; Tags: 'PostMortem' and 'Draft'; Fields: 'incident_date' (YYYY-MM-DD) and 'severity' (SEV-); Body: Must contain '!! Summary', '!! Root Cause', and '!! Resolution' headings.
